title: Understanding COVID-19 Vaccine Campaign on Facebook using Minimal Supervision
reasoning: The paper focuses on classifying Facebook ads using Moral Foundation Theory (MFT), identifying moral pillars such as Care/Harm, Fairness/Cheating, and Sanctity/Degradation. It also includes a specific classification theme for 'VaccineReligion' and evaluates the model's ability to detect these moral and religious frameworks in text.
